posts.body:
I created a resource to collect that I put on different maps, and depending on the map the player is on, the player gives you a different object, not the same object. (each map has a different variable)
It is a common event. It is a self-spamming event.
I know it's simple but I need if someone knows the script to verify if the player is on the map.

posts.author: sensen
posts.body:
I tried this but it doesn't work
Script: ThePlayerIsOn(1) (Conditional derivation)

posts.author: Kenen
posts.body:
Not sure I understand what you're asking. You can use the Control Variables event command to set the ID of the current map to a variable, and then use a Conditional Branch event command in your common event to do something based on the ID of the map.
You don't need to verify if the player is on the map. There is only one map active at one time.

posts.body:
Aside from the true things Kenen said, I don't understand the point of your plugin.

Or, if you want to use code and be more efficient, why make the function and plugin file instead of just pasting that into Conditional Branch's Script field?

or whatever.
